definition_en: The physical or mental power or skill needed to do something.

zhongkao.sentence: She has the ability to speak three languages fluently.
zhongkao.translation: 她有流利说三种语言的能力。

grade10.sentence: The scholarship is awarded to students who demonstrate exceptional academic ability.
grade10.translation: 该奖学金授予那些表现出卓越学术能力的学生。

definition_en: The right or opportunity to use or look at something; a way of entering or reaching a place.

zhongkao.sentence: Students have free access to the school library every day.
zhongkao.translation: 学生们每天都可以免费使用学校图书馆。

grade10.sentence: Many people in remote villages still lack access to clean water and electricity.
grade10.translation: 许多偏远村庄的人们仍然无法获得清洁的水源和电力。

definition_en: Used to show that what is true or happened is not what you might have expected.

zhongkao.sentence: I thought the test would be hard, but it was actually quite easy.
zhongkao.translation: 我以为考试会很难，但实际上它很容易。

grade10.sentence: Although he nodded in agreement, he actually held a completely different opinion.
grade10.translation: 虽然他点头表示同意，但他实际上持有完全不同的观点。

definition_en: Modern and well developed; at a higher, more difficult level.

zhongkao.sentence: This computer uses advanced technology to work faster.
zhongkao.translation: 这台电脑使用先进的技术来运行得更快。

grade10.sentence: The advanced course is designed for students who wish to pursue a career in medicine.
grade10.translation: 这门高级课程是为那些希望从事医学事业的学生设计的。

definition_en: A condition giving a greater chance of success; a helpful or useful quality.

zhongkao.sentence: One advantage of living in the countryside is the fresh air.
zhongkao.translation: 住在乡下的一个好处是空气新鲜。

grade10.sentence: You should take full advantage of the exchange program to improve your communication skills.
grade10.translation: 你应该充分利用这个交换项目来提高你的沟通技巧。

definition_en: To have enough money or time to be able to buy or do something.

zhongkao.sentence: I can't afford to buy a new computer right now.
zhongkao.translation: 我现在买不起新电脑。

grade10.sentence: We cannot afford to ignore the environmental problems we are facing today.
grade10.translation: 我们承担不起忽视当今面临的环境问题的后果。

definition_en: Not expensive; reasonably priced.
definition_cn: 负担得起的；价格合理的

zhongkao.sentence: This store sells nice clothes at affordable prices.
zhongkao.translation: 这家店以合理的价格出售漂亮的衣服。

grade10.sentence: The government is working hard to make housing more affordable for young people.
grade10.translation: 政府正在努力让年轻人更能负担得起住房。

definition_en: Used to say that something must happen before something else can happen.

zhongkao.sentence: You can go out to play as long as you finish your homework first.
zhongkao.translation: 只要你先完成作业，你就可以出去玩。

grade10.sentence: As long as you remain confident and persistent, you will eventually achieve your goals.
grade10.translation: 只要你保持自信和坚持，你终将实现你的目标。

definition_en: Happening together; also used to introduce a contrasting fact.

zhongkao.sentence: Please don't talk at the same time, or I can't hear you clearly.
zhongkao.translation: 请不要同时说话，否则我听不清楚。

grade10.sentence: He wants to travel the world, but at the same time, he doesn't want to leave his family behind.
grade10.translation: 他想周游世界，但与此同时，他又不想离开家人。

definition_en: The way you think and feel about someone or something.

zhongkao.sentence: Having a positive attitude can help you make more friends.
zhongkao.translation: 拥有积极的态度可以帮你交到更多朋友。

grade10.sentence: Your attitude towards failure often determines your future success.
grade10.translation: 你对失败的态度往往决定了你未来的成功。

definition_en: A person who is starting to learn or do something.

zhongkao.sentence: This swimming class is for beginners, so don't worry if you can't swim well.
zhongkao.translation: 这门游泳课是为初学者开设的，所以如果你游得不好也不要担心。

grade10.sentence: Even as a beginner, she showed remarkable talent for playing the violin.
grade10.translation: 即使作为一名初学者，她在拉小提琴方面也表现出了非凡的天赋。

definition_en: Not interesting or exciting.

zhongkao.sentence: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep halfway through it.
zhongkao.translation: 这部电影太无聊了，以至于我看到一半就睡着了。

grade10.sentence: He found the repetitive task extremely boring and wished for more challenging work.
grade10.translation: 他觉得这项重复性的工作极其枯燥，希望能做更有挑战性的工作。

definition_en: An opportunity to do something; a possibility.

zhongkao.sentence: If you have a chance to visit London, you should see Big Ben.
zhongkao.translation: 如果你有机会去伦敦，你应该去看看大本钟。

grade10.sentence: She realized that this internship was a golden chance to gain experience in her future career.
grade10.translation: 她意识到这次实习是为她未来职业生涯积累经验的绝佳机会。

definition_en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

zhongkao.sentence: I usually chat with my friends online after finishing my homework.
zhongkao.translation: 做完作业后，我通常会在网上和朋友聊天。

grade10.sentence: Instead of focusing on their project, the students spent the whole hour chatting about the weekend.
grade10.translation: 学生们没有专注于他们的项目，而是花了一整个小时聊周末的事情。

definition_en: To share or exchange information, news, or ideas.

zhongkao.sentence: It is important for parents and children to communicate with each other.
zhongkao.translation: 父母和孩子之间的相互沟通非常重要。

grade10.sentence: Effective leaders must be able to communicate their vision clearly to the entire team.
grade10.translation: 高效的领导者必须能够清晰地向整个团队传达他们的愿景。

definition_en: The process of sharing or exchanging information, ideas, or feelings.

zhongkao.sentence: Good communication is very important between parents and children.
zhongkao.translation: 父母和孩子之间良好的沟通非常重要。

grade10.sentence: Modern technology has revolutionized the way global communication takes place.
grade10.translation: 现代科技彻底改变了全球通讯的方式。

definition_en: The feeling that you can trust someone or something to be good or successful.

zhongkao.sentence: If you study hard, you will have more confidence in the exam.
zhongkao.translation: 如果你努力学习，你在考试中会更有信心。

grade10.sentence: Her lack of confidence prevented her from applying for the leadership position.
grade10.translation: 缺乏自信使她无法申请那个领导职位。

definition_en: A relationship in which a person, thing, or idea is linked or associated with something else.

zhongkao.sentence: Is there a direct bus connection between the airport and the hotel?
zhongkao.translation: 机场和酒店之间有直达巴士连接吗？

grade10.sentence: Scientists are studying the connection between air pollution and respiratory diseases.
grade10.translation: 科学家们正在研究空气污染与呼吸道疾病之间的联系。

definition_en: Happening or existing for a period of time without interruption.

zhongkao.sentence: The continuous rain made us stay at home all day.
zhongkao.translation: 持续不断的雨让我们整天待在家里。

grade10.sentence: The machine requires a continuous supply of electricity to function properly.
grade10.translation: 这台机器需要持续的电力供应才能正常运转。

definition_en: To make something new happen or exist.

zhongkao.sentence: We want to create a better world for everyone.
zhongkao.translation: 我们要为大家创造一个更美好的世界。

grade10.sentence: The new policy is designed to create more opportunities for small businesses.
grade10.translation: 这项新政策旨在为小企业创造更多机会。

definition_en: The habits, traditions, and beliefs of a particular group of people or society.

zhongkao.sentence: Different countries have different cultures, so we should learn to respect them.
zhongkao.translation: 不同的国家有不同的文化，所以我们应该学会尊重它们。

grade10.sentence: Learning a foreign language provides a unique bridge to understanding a new culture.
grade10.translation: 学习一门外语为理解一种新文化提供了独特的桥梁。

definition_en: A period of ten years.

zhongkao.sentence: The internet has changed our lives a lot in the past decade.
zhongkao.translation: 在过去的十年里，互联网极大地改变了我们的生活。

grade10.sentence: Over the last decade, significant progress has been made in environmental protection.
grade10.translation: 在过去的十年中，环境保护方面取得了重大进展。

definition_en: To make something happen later than expected or to cause someone to be late.

zhongkao.sentence: The bus was delayed because of the heavy snow.
zhongkao.translation: 由于大雪，公共汽车延误了。

grade10.sentence: Do not delay making a decision, or you might miss the opportunity.
grade10.translation: 不要拖延做决定，否则你可能会错失良机。

definition_en: Having many industries and a complex economic system; advanced.

zhongkao.sentence: Many developed countries are helping poor people in need.
zhongkao.translation: 许多发达国家正在帮助那些贫困的人。

grade10.sentence: She has developed a new method for solving complex mathematical problems.
grade10.translation: 她已经开发出一种解决复杂数学问题的新方法。

definition_en: The amount of space between two places or things.

zhongkao.sentence: My school is within walking distance of my home.
zhongkao.translation: 我的学校离我家很近，步行即可到达。

grade10.sentence: Despite the long distance between them, they managed to maintain a strong friendship.
grade10.translation: 尽管他们之间距离遥远，但他们设法保持了深厚的友谊。

definition_en: The process of teaching or learning, especially in a school or college.

zhongkao.sentence: A good education is important for every child's future.
zhongkao.translation: 良好的教育对每个孩子的未来都很重要。

grade10.sentence: The government has decided to invest more money in higher education to support scientific research.
grade10.translation: 政府决定向高等教育投入更多资金以支持科学研究。

definition_en: Producing the result that is wanted or intended.

zhongkao.sentence: Reading aloud is an effective way to learn English.
zhongkao.translation: 大声朗读是学习英语的一种有效方法。

grade10.sentence: The new traffic laws proved to be effective in reducing the number of accidents on the highway.
grade10.translation: 新的交通法规被证明在减少高速公路事故数量方面是有效的。

definition_en: The physical or mental strength that makes you able to do things.

zhongkao.sentence: You should eat breakfast to get enough energy for the morning.
zhongkao.translation: 你应该吃早餐来获取早晨所需的充足精力。

grade10.sentence: Developing renewable energy sources is crucial for protecting our environment from pollution.
grade10.translation: 开发可再生能源对于保护我们的环境免受污染至关重要。

definition_en: The act of giving hope or support to someone.

zhongkao.sentence: With the teacher's encouragement, the shy boy finally answered the question.
zhongkao.translation: 在老师的鼓励下，那个害羞的男孩终于回答了问题。

grade10.sentence: Words of encouragement from his parents gave him the confidence to face the difficult challenge.
grade10.translation: 父母的鼓励之词给了他面对这一艰难挑战的信心。

definition_en: Completely necessary or extremely important.

zhongkao.sentence: Water is essential to all living things.
zhongkao.translation: 水对所有生物都是必不可少的。

grade10.sentence: Good communication skills are essential for building strong relationships in a multicultural team.
grade10.translation: 良好的沟通技巧对于在多元文化团队中建立牢固的关系是至关重要的。

definition_en: To think or believe something will happen, or someone will arrive.

zhongkao.sentence: We expect to see you at the school party tomorrow.
zhongkao.translation: 我们期待明天在学校聚会上见到你。

grade10.sentence: The scientists expect that the new technology will reduce energy consumption significantly.
grade10.translation: 科学家们预计这项新技术将显著降低能源消耗。

definition_en: Knowledge or skill from doing, seeing, or feeling things; something that happens to you.

zhongkao.sentence: My grandfather has a lot of experience in gardening.
zhongkao.translation: 我的祖父在园艺方面有很多经验。

grade10.sentence: Volunteering in the rural area was a valuable experience that changed my perspective on life.
grade10.translation: 在农村地区做志愿者是一次宝贵的经历，改变了我对生活的看法。

definition_en: To show a feeling, opinion, or fact through words or actions.

zhongkao.sentence: It is hard for him to express his feelings in words.
zhongkao.translation: 他很难用语言表达他的感受。

grade10.sentence: Many artists use painting as a medium to express complex social issues.
grade10.translation: 许多艺术家利用绘画作为媒介来表达复杂的社会问题。

definition_en: Close together and looking at each other; in person.

zhongkao.sentence: Instead of calling, let's meet face to face to talk about it.
zhongkao.translation: 与其打电话，不如我们面对面谈谈这事。

grade10.sentence: Although online classes are convenient, face-to-face interaction is often more effective for group discussions.
grade10.translation: 虽然网课很方便，但面对面的互动通常在小组讨论中更有效。

definition_en: Easy to recognize because of being seen, met, heard, etc. before.

zhongkao.sentence: This street looks familiar; I think I have been here before.
zhongkao.translation: 这条街看起来很眼熟；我想我以前来过这里。

grade10.sentence: Before traveling abroad, you should become familiar with the local customs and laws.
grade10.translation: 在出国旅行之前，你应该熟悉当地的风俗和法律。

definition_en: To give a lot of attention to one particular person, subject, or thing.

zhongkao.sentence: You should focus on your studies and stop playing video games all day.
zhongkao.translation: 你应该专注于学习，不要整天玩电子游戏。

grade10.sentence: The camera lens could not focus properly, resulting in a blurry image of the landscape.
grade10.translation: 照相机镜头无法正确对焦，导致风景图像模糊。

definition_en: To get something that is useful, that gives you an advantage, or that is in some way positive.

zhongkao.sentence: Reading books helps us gain knowledge and learn about the world.
zhongkao.translation: 读书帮助我们获取知识并了解世界。

grade10.sentence: Despite the initial difficulties, the team managed to gain a competitive edge in the market.
grade10.translation: 尽管起初困难重重，团队还是设法在市场上获得了竞争优势。

definition_en: The set of rules that explain how words are used in a language.

zhongkao.sentence: Our English teacher often tells us that grammar is the skeleton of a language.
zhongkao.translation: 我们的英语老师经常告诉我们，语法是语言的骨架。

grade10.sentence: Mastering complex grammar structures is essential for writing high-quality academic essays.
grade10.translation: 掌握复杂的语法结构对于撰写高质量的学术论文至关重要。

definition_en: Relating to people or their characteristics.

zhongkao.sentence: Dogs are often considered to be human's best friends.
zhongkao.translation: 狗通常被认为是人类最好的朋友。

grade10.sentence: The documentary explored the impact of human activity on the ocean ecosystem.
grade10.translation: 这部纪录片探讨了人类活动对海洋生态系统的影响。

definition_en: To intentionally not listen or give attention to.

zhongkao.sentence: It is rude to ignore others when they are saying hello to you.
zhongkao.translation: 当别人向你打招呼时置之不理是不礼貌的。

grade10.sentence: The government cannot afford to ignore the growing problem of unemployment among young people.
grade10.translation: 政府不能忽视年轻人中日益严重的失业问题。

definition_en: To form a picture or idea in your mind of something that is not real or present.

zhongkao.sentence: Can you imagine living on the moon in the future?
zhongkao.translation: 你能想象未来住在月球上吗？

grade10.sentence: It is difficult to imagine how people survived without electricity in ancient times.
grade10.translation: 很难想象古代人在没有电的情况下是如何生存的。

definition_en: To make something better than before.

zhongkao.sentence: I want to improve my English, so I listen to the radio every morning.
zhongkao.translation: 我想提高我的英语水平，所以我每天早上听广播。

grade10.sentence: The factory introduced new technology to improve production efficiency and reduce waste.
grade10.translation: 这家工厂引进了新技术以提高生产效率并减少浪费。

definition_en: Not correct or exact; containing errors.

zhongkao.sentence: The answer he gave was inaccurate, so the teacher asked him to try again.
zhongkao.translation: 他给出的答案不准确，所以老师让他再试一次。

grade10.sentence: The weather forecast was inaccurate, causing many tourists to be unprepared for the sudden storm.
grade10.translation: 天气预报不准确，导致许多游客对突如其来的暴风雨毫无准备。

definition_en: Problems or trouble caused to someone; the quality of not being convenient.

zhongkao.sentence: We are sorry for the inconvenience caused by the train delay.
zhongkao.translation: 对于火车晚点给您带来的不便，我们深表歉意。

grade10.sentence: Living far from the city center can be a major inconvenience for people who do not own a car.
grade10.translation: 对于没有车的人来说，住在远离市中心的地方可能会带来极大的不便。

definition_en: To become or make something larger or greater in amount.

zhongkao.sentence: The price of vegetables has increased this year.
zhongkao.translation: 今年蔬菜的价格上涨了。

grade10.sentence: There has been a significant increase in the number of students applying for overseas universities.
grade10.translation: 申请海外大学的学生人数有了显著增加。

definition_en: To fill someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something, especially to do something creative.

zhongkao.sentence: My teacher inspired me to read more books.
zhongkao.translation: 我的老师激励我多读书。

grade10.sentence: The story of the brave firefighter inspired the whole community to help those in need.
grade10.translation: 那位勇敢的消防员的故事激励了整个社区去帮助有需要的人。

definition_en: Coming between two things in time, place, character, etc.; middle level.

zhongkao.sentence: He is taking an intermediate English class this term.
zhongkao.translation: 这学期他在上中级英语课。

grade10.sentence: The runner paused at an intermediate point in the race to drink some water.
grade10.translation: 赛跑者在比赛的中间点停下来喝了点水。

definition_en: Having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm; very interested.

zhongkao.sentence: Tom is keen on playing football with his friends.
zhongkao.translation: 汤姆非常热衷于和朋友们踢足球。

grade10.sentence: She has a keen eye for detail, which makes her an excellent editor.
grade10.translation: 她对细节有敏锐的洞察力，这使她成为一名出色的编辑。

definition_en: Facts, information, and skills acquired by a person through experience or education.

zhongkao.sentence: We can get a lot of knowledge from the Internet.
zhongkao.translation: 我们可以从互联网上获得很多知识。

grade10.sentence: Scientific knowledge is essential for the development of modern technology.
grade10.translation: 科学知识对于现代技术的发展至关重要。

definition_en: Probable; such as well might happen or be true.

zhongkao.sentence: It is likely to be sunny tomorrow.
zhongkao.translation: 明天很可能是晴天。

grade10.sentence: Experts believe that the new policy is likely to improve the local economy significantly.
grade10.translation: 专家认为这项新政策很可能会显著改善当地经济。

definition_en: A point or level beyond which something does not or may not extend.

zhongkao.sentence: You should limit the time you spend on your mobile phone.
zhongkao.translation: 你应该限制你花在手机上的时间。

grade10.sentence: The speed limit on this highway is 100 kilometers per hour.
grade10.translation: 这条高速公路的限速是每小时100公里。

definition_en: The idea that is represented by a word, phrase, or action.

zhongkao.sentence: Can you tell me the meaning of this new word?
zhongkao.translation: 你能告诉我这个生词的意思吗？

grade10.sentence: Volunteering gave him a sense of meaning and purpose in life.
grade10.translation: 志愿服务给了他生活中的意义感和目标感。

definition_en: A method or way of doing something.

zhongkao.sentence: Using a bike is a healthy means of transport.
zhongkao.translation: 骑自行车是一种健康的交通方式。

grade10.sentence: Language is a means of communication shared by people within a society.
grade10.translation: 语言是社会中人们共有的一种交流工具。

definition_en: To learn something so that you remember it exactly.

zhongkao.sentence: It is not easy to memorize all these names in one day.
zhongkao.translation: 一天之内记下所有这些名字并不容易。

grade10.sentence: Instead of trying to memorize facts, you should try to understand the concepts.
grade10.translation: 你不应该试图死记硬背事实，而应该尝试理解这些概念。

definition_en: To speak about something quickly without giving much detail.

zhongkao.sentence: Did he mention when the party will start?
zhongkao.translation: 他提到聚会什么时候开始了吗？

grade10.sentence: The article mentions the importance of protecting the environment multiple times.
grade10.translation: 这篇文章多次提到了保护环境的重要性。

definition_en: A particular way of doing something.

zhongkao.sentence: This new method helps us learn English words faster.
zhongkao.translation: 这种新方法帮助我们更快地学习英语单词。

grade10.sentence: Scientists have developed a more effective method for purifying water in rural areas.
grade10.translation: 科学家们已经开发出一种更有效的方法来净化农村地区的水。

definition_en: Typical, usual, or ordinary; what you expect.

zhongkao.sentence: It is normal to feel a little nervous before a big exam.
zhongkao.translation: 在大考前感到有点紧张是正常的。

grade10.sentence: Under normal circumstances, the library is open until 9 p.m., but today it closed early.
grade10.translation: 在正常情况下，图书馆开到晚上9点，但今天它提早关门了。

definition_en: Able to accept delays or problems without becoming annoyed; (noun) a person receiving medical treatment.
definition_cn: 有耐心的；(名词) 病人

zhongkao.sentence: Please be patient while waiting for the bus.
zhongkao.translation: 等公交车的时候请耐心一点。

grade10.sentence: The doctor explained the complex surgery to the patient and his family very carefully.
grade10.translation: 医生非常仔细地向病人及其家属解释了这项复杂的手术。

definition_en: A small group of words that stands together as a meaningful unit.

zhongkao.sentence: Can you make a sentence with the phrase 'look after'?
zhongkao.translation: 你能用“look after”这个短语造个句吗？

grade10.sentence: In his speech, the president repeated a catchy phrase to emphasize his commitment to change.
grade10.translation: 在其演讲中，总统重复了一个朗朗上口的短语以强调他对于变革的承诺。

definition_en: Used to mean that something is very likely to happen or to be true.

zhongkao.sentence: It is cloudy, so it will probably rain this afternoon.
zhongkao.translation: 天阴了，所以今天下午很可能会下雨。

grade10.sentence: The ancient vase is probably the most valuable item in the entire museum collection.
grade10.translation: 这个古老的花瓶大概是整个博物馆藏品中最有价值的物品。

definition_en: Movement to an improved or developed state, or to move forward.

zhongkao.sentence: I hope to make great progress in English this term.
zhongkao.translation: 我希望这学期在英语上取得巨大进步。

grade10.sentence: Rapid technological progress has completely changed the way we communicate with each other.
grade10.translation: 科技的飞速进步彻底改变了我们彼此沟通的方式。

definition_en: To make the sound of a word or letter with your voice.

zhongkao.sentence: Can you tell me how to pronounce this new word correctly?
zhongkao.translation: 你能告诉我如何正确地发这个生词的音吗？

grade10.sentence: Although he knew the meaning of the word, he hesitated to pronounce it in front of the class.
grade10.translation: 虽然他知道这个词的意思，但他犹豫着不敢在全班面前读出来。

definition_en: The way in which a word or language is spoken.

zhongkao.sentence: Your pronunciation is excellent because you practice listening every day.
zhongkao.translation: 你的发音很棒，因为你每天都练习听力。

grade10.sentence: Focusing on intonation and stress is just as important as correct pronunciation when learning a foreign language.
grade10.translation: 在学习外语时，关注语调和重音与正确的发音同样重要。

definition_en: To give someone something that they need.

zhongkao.sentence: The hotel provides a free breakfast for all guests.
zhongkao.translation: 这家酒店为所有客人提供免费早餐。

grade10.sentence: The government promised to provide the victims with food, water, and medical supplies immediately.
grade10.translation: 政府承诺立即向受害者提供食物、水和医疗物资。

definition_en: To need something or make something necessary.

zhongkao.sentence: This plant requires a lot of sunlight and water to grow well.
zhongkao.translation: 这种植物需要大量的阳光和水才能长得好。

grade10.sentence: Students are required to hand in their research papers by the end of the month.
grade10.translation: 学生们被要求在月底前上交他们的研究论文。

definition_en: A person who studies a subject in detail in order to discover new information.

zhongkao.sentence: The researcher studies how animals live in the forest.
zhongkao.translation: 这位研究员研究动物如何在森林里生活。

grade10.sentence: The lead researcher presented the data collected from the experiment to the scientific community.
grade10.translation: 首席研究员向科学界展示了从实验中收集的数据。

definition_en: Something that a country, person, or organization has that they can use.

zhongkao.sentence: Water is a very important resource for human beings.
zhongkao.translation: 水对人类来说是非常重要的资源。

grade10.sentence: We must learn to manage our natural resources wisely to ensure sustainable development.
grade10.translation: 我们必须学会明智地管理自然资源，以确保可持续发展。

definition_en: A group of words that expresses a complete thought, or a punishment given by a judge.

zhongkao.sentence: Can you make a sentence with this new word?
zhongkao.translation: 你能用这个新单词造个句子吗？

grade10.sentence: The judge passed a heavy sentence on the thief for his crimes.
grade10.translation: 法官因窃贼的罪行对他判处了重刑。

definition_en: The ability to do something well, usually gained through training or experience.

zhongkao.sentence: Cooking is a useful skill to learn at home.
zhongkao.translation: 烹饪是在家里学习的一项有用技能。

grade10.sentence: Effective communication is a vital skill required in almost every profession.
grade10.translation: 有效的沟通几乎是每个职业都需要的至关重要的技能。

definition_en: A vehicle used for traveling in outer space.

zhongkao.sentence: The astronauts returned to the earth in a spaceship.
zhongkao.translation: 宇航员乘坐宇宙飞船返回地球。

grade10.sentence: Engineers are designing a new spaceship capable of carrying supplies to Mars.
grade10.translation: 工程师们正在设计一种能够向火星运送物资的新型宇宙飞船。

definition_en: To continue to be in a particular place or state without changing.

zhongkao.sentence: It is raining outside, so I will stay at home today.
zhongkao.translation: 外面在下雨，所以我今天会待在家里。

grade10.sentence: To stay healthy, you should exercise regularly and eat a balanced diet.
grade10.translation: 为了保持健康，你应该定期锻炼并保持饮食平衡。

definition_en: To attach something to a surface; to remain firm to a decision or promise.

zhongkao.sentence: Please stick a stamp on the envelope before you mail it.
zhongkao.translation: 寄信前请在信封上贴一张邮票。

grade10.sentence: If we stick to our original plan, we can finish the project on time.
grade10.translation: 如果我们坚持原来的计划，我们就能按时完成项目。

definition_en: Continuing to happen or exist; not moving or making a sound.

zhongkao.sentence: Is your brother still sleeping in his bedroom?
zhongkao.translation: 你弟弟还在卧室里睡觉吗？

grade10.sentence: You need to stand completely still while the doctor takes the X-ray.
grade10.translation: 医生拍X光片时，你需要完全站着不动。

definition_en: To help or encourage someone; to hold something up so it does not fall.

zhongkao.sentence: My friends always support me when I feel sad.
zhongkao.translation: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们总是支持我。

grade10.sentence: The evidence does not support the theory that the climate changed suddenly.
grade10.translation: 证据不支持气候突然变化这一理论。

definition_en: From one side or end of something to the other; by means of.

zhongkao.sentence: The sunlight came in through the window.
zhongkao.translation: 阳光透过窗户照了进来。

grade10.sentence: We learned a lot about history through visiting various museums in Europe.
grade10.translation: 通过参观欧洲的各种博物馆，我们学到了很多历史知识。

definition_en: In every part of a place; during the whole period of time.

zhongkao.sentence: It rained heavily throughout the night.
zhongkao.translation: 整夜都在下大雨。

grade10.sentence: The theme of forgiveness is present throughout the entire novel.
grade10.translation: 宽恕的主题贯穿了整部小说。

definition_en: A small piece of advice; the pointed end of something; extra money given for service.

zhongkao.sentence: Our teacher gave us some tips on how to learn English well.
zhongkao.translation: 我们老师给了我们一些关于如何学好英语的建议。

grade10.sentence: It is customary to leave a tip for the waiter in many Western countries.
grade10.translation: 在许多西方国家，给服务员留小费是一种习俗。

definition_en: A unit for measuring weight; a large amount (informal).

zhongkao.sentence: This elephant weighs about four tons.
zhongkao.translation: 这头大象重约四吨。

grade10.sentence: I have a ton of homework to finish before the deadline tomorrow.
grade10.translation: 在明天截止日期之前，我有一大堆作业要完成。

definition_en: The soft part inside the mouth used for tasting and speaking; a language.

zhongkao.sentence: The doctor asked the boy to open his mouth and show his tongue.
zhongkao.translation: 医生让那个男孩张开嘴伸出舌头。

grade10.sentence: Although she has lived abroad for years, Chinese remains her mother tongue.
grade10.translation: 虽然她在国外生活多年，但中文仍然是她的母语。

definition_en: To change words into a different language.

zhongkao.sentence: Can you translate this English story into Chinese?
zhongkao.translation: 你能把这个英语故事翻译成中文吗？

grade10.sentence: The software can automatically translate text, but it sometimes makes grammatical errors.
grade10.translation: 这个软件可以自动翻译文本，但它有时会犯语法错误。

definition_en: The importance, worth, or usefulness of something.

zhongkao.sentence: This old book is of great value to me because my grandfather gave it to me.
zhongkao.translation: 这本旧书对我来说很有价值，因为它是爷爷送给我的。

grade10.sentence: Learning to appreciate the value of failure is an essential part of personal growth.
grade10.translation: 学会欣赏失败的价值是个人成长中不可或缺的一部分。

definition_en: A particular form of something that is slightly different from other forms of the same thing.

zhongkao.sentence: Please make sure you have the latest version of the software installed on your computer.
zhongkao.translation: 请确保你的电脑上安装了该软件的最新版本。

grade10.sentence: The two drivers gave different versions of the accident to the police officer.
grade10.translation: 这两位司机向警官提供了关于事故的两种不同说法。

definition_en: Existing or happening in many places or among many people.

zhongkao.sentence: Computers are widespread in schools today.
zhongkao.translation: 如今电脑在学校里非常普及。

grade10.sentence: There is widespread concern among scientists regarding the rapid changes in global climate.
grade10.translation: 科学家们普遍对全球气候的快速变化感到担忧。

definition_en: Not having, using, or doing something.

zhongkao.sentence: We cannot live without water or air.
zhongkao.translation: 没有水和空气，我们无法生存。

grade10.sentence: She managed to solve the complex math problem without referring to the textbook.
grade10.translation: 她在没有参考课本的情况下成功解决这道复杂的数学题。

question: Find the odd one out.
analysis: B、C、D项（words单词、grammar语法、pronunciation发音）均为语言构成的基本要素；A项（encouragement鼓励）属于心理或情感支持层面，不属于语言本身的结构要素。

question: Find the odd one out.
analysis: A、B、C项（talk谈话、chat聊天、express表达）均表示沟通交流的动作（动词）；D项（phrase短语）是名词，指语言单位，词性及语义范畴与其他三项不同。

question: Find the odd one out.
analysis: A、C、D项（intermediate中级的、beginner初学者/初级的、advanced高级的）均表示学习的级别或程度；B项（learner学习者）指人，与其他三项描述级别的词不同。

question: Find the odd one out.
analysis: 本单元词汇表中，A、B、D项（culture文化、value价值观、knowledge知识）均为名词；C项（gain获得）主要作为动词使用，词性与其他三项不同。

question: Find the odd one out.
analysis: A、C、D项中的前缀“in-”均表示否定含义（“不”）；B项（inspire激励）中的“in-”表示方向（“入”），不含否定意义。此外，inspire是动词，其他几项为名词或形容词。

question: She was in ______ throughout the race.
analysis: 句意：她在整场比赛中一直处于领先位置。in advance 可表示“在前头、预先”，这里引申为在比赛中处于前列/领先。

question: These problems cannot be ______ or just washed away.
analysis: 句意：这些问题不能被忽视或仅仅被冲刷掉。cannot be ignored 意为“不能被忽视”，符合语境。

question: I gave it a try once, but I found fishing really ______.
analysis: 句意：我试过一次，但我发现钓鱼真的很无聊。found sth. + adj. 发现某事……；boring 意为“无聊的”，形容 fishing。

question: There is no ______ to the street through that door.
analysis: 句意：通过那扇门没有通往街道的通道。access to... 意为“通往……的通路/入口”。

question: Great changes have taken place in the last ______.
analysis: 句意：在过去的十年里发生了巨大的变化。decade 意为“十年”，in the last decade 是常见搭配。

question: The brain needs a ______ supply of blood.
analysis: 句意：大脑需要持续的血液供应。continuous 意为“持续的”，修饰名词 supply。

question: People's ______ towards money is changing.
analysis: 句意：人们对金钱的态度正在改变。attitude towards... 意为“对……的态度”。

question: I don't think we can ______ a new house.
analysis: 句意：我认为我们买不起新房子。afford 意为“买得起、承担得起”，常与 can/could 连用。

question: ______ have found the connection between smoking and heart disease.
analysis: 句意：研究人员已经发现了吸烟和心脏病之间的联系。句首缺主语，Researchers（研究人员）符合语境。

question: segporrs
analysis: n. 进步，进展

question: xreineecpe
analysis: n. 经验；经历

question: onenifcecd
analysis: n. 信心，自信

question: sseeaitnl
analysis: adj. 必要的，本质的

question: nnoi tem
analysis: v. 提及，提到

question: ekne
analysis: adj. 热心的；敏锐的；渴望的

question: leevdpo
analysis: v. 发展；开发

question: What is the truth? I have heard two v______ of the accident.
analysis: 句意：真相是什么？我听到了关于这次事故的两个版本。根据“two”可知此处需用复数名词。单词“version”意为“版本”，符合语境。

question: It is so nice of the host; he p______ lunch for all the guests.
analysis: 句意：主人真好；他为所有客人提供了午餐。根据语境和首字母p，意为“提供”，英语为provide。描述过去发生的动作，使用过去式provided。

question: I might know her. Her name sounded really f______ to me.
analysis: 句意：我可能认识她。她的名字听起来真的很熟悉。短语“sound familiar”意为“听起来熟悉”。

question: We never i______ that men would land on the moon by spaceships.
analysis: 句意：我们从未想象过人类会乘坐宇宙飞船登上月球。根据首字母i和语境，单词为imagine（想象）。因从句使用了would，主句通常使用过去时imagined。

question: Listen! Birds are singing somewhere at a d______ . It's so beautiful!
analysis: 句意：听！鸟儿在远处歌唱。太美了！固定短语“at a distance”意为“在远处”。

question: What terrible weather! How long will this flight be d______ ?
analysis: 句意：天气真糟糕！这趟航班要延误多久？根据语境和首字母d，单词为delay（延误）。will be后接过去分词构成被动语态，故填delayed。

question: You are r______ to hand in your paper before this Saturday.
analysis: 句意：你被要求在本周六之前交论文。根据首字母r和语境，单词为require（要求）。此处为被动语态“be required to do sth.”，故填required。

question: We need to find a simple and e______ method for solving these problems.
analysis: 句意：我们需要找到一种简单且有效的方法来解决这些问题。and连接并列形容词，根据首字母e，单词为effective（有效的）。

article: As a child, you are expected to make mistakes. But an adult is more [1] to say "I can't" or "I haven't learned that yet." It's okay for beginners to make mistakes and say wrong [2]. Even when you become an [3] or advanced learner, it's very normal that you make mistakes, like [4] incorrectly, or using inaccurate words. But all that matters is to communicate. As [5] as people can get your meaning, it would be a successful [6].

questions.analysis: 考查形容词辨析。句意：但是成年人更可能说“我不能”或“我还没学会”。be likely to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“可能做某事”。always是副词，agree是动词，均不符合语境。故选A。
考查名词复数。句意：初学者犯错并说错句子是可以的。这里表示泛指，且前面没有冠词，应当用名词复数形式 sentences。A和B均为单数，若使用需加冠词。故选C。
考查形容词辨析。句意：即使当你成为一名中级或高级学习者时。空格前有不定冠词 an，说明后面的词以元音音素开头，A（clever）和C（superior）均以辅音开头，排除。intermediate 意为“中级的”，符合语境及语法。故选B。
考查非谓语动词。句意：比如发音不正确。like 在此处是介词，后接动词 ing 形式作宾语。pronounce 是动词原形，pronunciation 是名词（无法被副词 incorrectly 修饰），pronouncing 是动名词。故选B。
考查固定短语。句意：只要人们能理解你的意思。as long as 是固定搭配，意为“只要”。故选A。
考查词性辨析。句意：那将是一次成功的交流。successful 是形容词，修饰名词。communicate 是动词，communicating 是动名词/现在分词，communication 是名词。故选C。
